blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Sixty-one learners who have been holding classes at the school stage and covered court of Burgos Elementary School in Albay’s Daraga town, will finally have classrooms of their own following the inauguration of a new two-classroom building on Friday (Sept. 25) The P9.65-million building was constructed by the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) through an initiative of the Ako Bicol party-list group under the Department of Education’s Basic Educational Facility Fund. The one-storey building has separate comfort rooms for boys and girls, including a facility for persons with disabilities. READ: Albay under state of calamity as […]...
